description_en: Grant permissions to a service account
description_zh: 该接口用于授权服务账号
kebab_example: aliyun rds grant-operator-permission --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --expired-time 2019-03-27T16:00:00Z --privileges Control --region cn-hangzhou
name: GrantOperatorPermission

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The expiration time of the permissions. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: expired_time

parameters.help_en:
The permissions that you want to grant to the service account. Valid values:

Control: the configuration permissions, which allow you to view and modify configurations of the instance.
Data: the data permissions, which allow you to view schemas, indexes, and SQL statements of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
授权类型。取值：
Control：配置权限。支持查看、修改实例配置。
Data：数据权限。支持查看表结构、索引和SQL
parameters.name: privileges
